title: Constructed direct-image coordinates for proper projection
statement: Fix D,C,E as in [def-fix-six-functor-datum], H a higher-operation datum, invertibility of the coefficient prime, and realized system operations o,z from [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]. On each finite-type k-scheme W, let reduce_W be the full constructible inclusion followed by whole-system coefficient reduction. The natural tensor comparison is datumTensorReductionIso of [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data], in curried notation. For f:X→Y, pullComparison is reduction of the prescribed completed pullback value followed by the actual reconstruction counit. Define direct_f as the adjunction mate of pullComparison inverse under the recorded pull/direct adjunctions. The direct source coordinate is tensor reduction followed by tensor of direct and identity. The direct target coordinate is direct on the tensor/pullback input followed by direct image of inputReduction inverse. Define openIdentity from the canonical sectionwise bridge to exact identity-open extension. All these maps are explicit constructions; no projection square or arbitrary existence choice defines them.

source.place: Compatibility of the specified maps under successive coefficient reductions; proper-coincidence and identity-open unit normalization

proof.text: Construct the tensor natural transformation from datumTensorReductionIso. Construct the pullback natural isomorphism from the prescribed completed pullback value and the actual counit; naturality is the composite naturality equation. Take its inverse adjunction mate to define direct. Compose these specified maps to form source and target, and compose the canonical bridge with identity-open extension to form openIdentity. No further existence assertion is used.
